description: This file is a shell script for testing case-insensitive pathspec matching in Git. It defines test cases that verify the functionality of Git commands such as 'git log', 'git ls-files', and 'git diff' with special pathspec syntax like ':(icase)'. The script sets up test repositories, creates commits with varying file names, and checks that pathspec matching behaves correctly in case-insensitive file systems.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, running the provided commands and verifying their output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.
